summary: ThermoIntel Task 3 (FIRMS hourly scheduler) fully verified. All 64 backend pytest tests pass (56 regression + 8 new scheduler tests). Frontend dashboard smoke test loads correctly with All India scope, 6 demo markers, no page errors.
